what_its_for: Bepotastine besilate eye drops are used to treat itchy eyes caused by allergies. It works by blocking a chemical in your body called histamine, which is responsible for causing the itching and irritation in your eyes during allergic reactions.
how_to_take: This medication is used as eye drops only — do not swallow it. Wash your hands before using. Tilt your head back, pull down your lower eyelid to create a small pocket, and place 1 drop into the affected eye or eyes. Gently close your eye for 1 to 2 minutes and press lightly on the inside corner of your eye (near your nose) to prevent the drops from draining. Do not let the dropper tip touch your eye, fingers, or any other surface to avoid contamination. If you wear contact lenses, remove them before putting in the drops and wait at least 10 minutes before putting your contacts back in.
dosing: The usual dose for adults and children 2 years of age and older is 1 drop into the affected eye(s) twice a day (once in the morning and once in the evening). Use it at the same times each day. Do not use more drops than prescribed.
missed_dose: If you miss a dose, use it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and go back to your regular dosing schedule. Do not use extra drops to make up for a missed dose.
storage: Store bepotastine besilate eye drops at room temperature between 59°F and 77°F (15°C to 25°C). Keep the bottle tightly closed when not in use. Keep it away from heat, direct light, and moisture. Do not freeze. Keep this medication out of reach of children and pets. Throw away any unused medication after the expiration date on the bottle.
what_to_avoid: Avoid touching the dropper tip to your eyes, hands, or any surfaces to prevent contamination. Do not wear contact lenses if your eyes are red or irritated. Avoid rubbing your eyes after applying the drops. Be careful when driving or operating machinery right after using the drops, as your vision may be temporarily blurry.
when_to_call_doctor: Contact your doctor or seek medical help right away if you experience: severe eye pain or increased eye redness, swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, difficulty breathing or swallowing (signs of a serious allergic reaction), vision changes that do not go away, signs of eye infection such as increased discharge or worsening symptoms, or if your eye condition does not improve or gets worse after a few days of use.
when_it_works: Bepotastine besilate starts working quickly, usually within a few minutes of putting the drops in your eyes. Most people notice relief from itching soon after the first dose. It may take a few days of regular use to get the full benefit. Always use it as directed even if your symptoms feel better.
special_populations: Children: This medication is approved for use in children 2 years of age and older. It has not been studied in children younger than 2 years. Older Adults: No special dose adjustment is needed for older adults, but let your doctor know about all other medications you take. Pregnancy and Breastfeeding: If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, talk to your doctor before using this medication. It is not fully known how it may affect your baby. Kidney or Liver Problems: If you have kidney or liver disease, tell your doctor before using this medication, as they may need to monitor you more closely.
